free_tier.stated: Privat Gratis: upp till 10 Mbit/s fair use, /60 prefix som standard (16 subnat), mojlighet upp till /48 efter behov, pris 0 kr per manad [quoted from a Swedish page with diacritics transliterated to ASCII]

egress.terms: no monthly byte allowance; the free plan is capped at 'Upp till 10 Mbit/s fair use'; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: an order form or email to karabro.se; the tunnel is built by hand
tooling: manual: the operator emails the configuration, then wg-quick, GRE or a SIT interface
chaining: not chainable for a user: a free VM's IPv4 is almost always outside Sweden or classified as a hosting/VPN address.

limits.value: up to 10 Mbit/s fair use on the free plan
no automatic provisioning: an order form or an email, then a human builds the tunnel

binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary fails at 1 TiB/month: 10 Mbit/s sustains about 3.2 TB/month, and no byte quota is published. What fails is identity, before the first byte - a Swedish personal identity number and a Swedish-registered, non-VPN IPv4 endpoint - and the seven kinds have no name for that, so it is recorded in identity_cost and decides the verdict.

identity_cost.detail: 'Vi behover ditt namn, din address och personnummer for att kunna folja svensk lagstiftning' (name, address and Swedish personal identity number), and 'Vi tillater bara endpoint IPv4-adresser som ar registrerade i Sverige och som inte ar klassade som VPN eller Proxyadresser' (only Swedish-registered IPv4 endpoints that are not classified as VPN or proxy).

reliability_note: ports 25 and 465 are blocked by default; no SLA on the free plan ('Ingen SLA och best effort').
confidence_note: documented from the vendor's Swedish order page read today. Nothing here would be raised by a probe, because the account cannot be created without a Swedish identity number.

notes: Operated by Karabro on AS51519 from Malmo. The paid plans at 60 SEK/month and up lift the speed and add BGP; the free plan is explicitly non-commercial. The endpoint restriction excludes VPN and proxy addresses, which rules out most free compute instances. the wording is otherwise as served. Technically the best free offer found on paper: WireGuard, 10 Mbit/s, /60 with /48 on request, no byte meter, Swedish addresses. Every one of those advantages is unreachable without a Swedish personal identity number and a Swedish-registered endpoint address, so the quota is worth zero for a user. SMTP ports 25 and 465 are blocked by default.

extras.wg_detail: WireGuard is one of three tunnel types: 'Vi stjoder foljande tunneltyper: Generic Routing Encapsulation, GRE / Wireguard / 6in4 (SIT)'. The config is written by hand by the operator because there is no automation.
